summary: Creates spherical POP geometry as geodesic, grid, tetrahedron, or shared-pole sphere forms. It can emit different connectivity types, partial longitude/latitude ranges, normals, texture coordinates, and dimension metadata.

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Sphere construction mode: geodesic, grid, tetrahedron, or shared poles

key_params.name: geodesictype
key_params.note: Connectivity for geodesic mode

key_params.name: surftype
key_params.note: Connectivity for grid mode

key_params.name: linetype
key_params.note: Line strip or lines output for line connectivity

key_params.name: orient
key_params.note: Axis that sphere poles align with

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Use connected input POP bounds as the starting sphere bounds

key_params.name: rad
key_params.note: Radii for ellipsoid shapes

key_params.name: freq
key_params.note: Subdivision frequency for geodesic spheres

key_params.name: fuse
key_params.note: Fuse subdivided triangles in geodesic mode

key_params.name: fusetechnique
key_params.note: Technique used to fuse geodesic subdivisions

key_params.name: cols
key_params.note: Grid mode columns

key_params.name: rows
key_params.note: Grid mode rows

key_params.name: anchoru
key_params.note: Anchor left, middle, or right side at X=0

key_params.name: anchorv
key_params.note: Anchor bottom, middle, or top side at Y=0

key_params.name: anchorw
key_params.note: Anchor back, middle, or front side at Z=0

key_params.name: t
key_params.note: Post-translate generated points

key_params.name: r
key_params.note: Post-rotate generated points in degrees

key_params.name: scale
key_params.note: Uniform post-scale for generated points

key_params.name: normal
key_params.note: Create point or vertex N attributes

key_params.name: texture
key_params.note: Create point or vertex Tex attributes

key_params.name: texmethod
key_params.note: Equirectangular or fisheye texture projection method

key_params.name: fov
key_params.note: Field-of-view angle for fisheye texture mapping

key_params.name: sharedpolessurftype
key_params.note: Connectivity for shared-pole sphere mode

key_params.name: closedu
key_params.note: Close grid sphere geometry in U

key_params.name: angleu
key_params.note: Begin and end angle for the U range

key_params.name: texrangeu
key_params.note: Texture-coordinate range mode in U

key_params.name: anglev
key_params.note: Begin and end angle for the V range

key_params.name: texrangev
key_params.note: Texture-coordinate range mode in V

common_gotchas: Grid spheres output dimension metadata that GLSL and downstream POPs can use.
Use Detail page latitude/longitude ranges for partial spheres instead of deleting points downstream.
Texture method matters for inside/outside sphere mapping and fisheye/equirectangular projections.
